description: Defines string manipulation functions for the Starboard platform, including string duplication, comparison (case-insensitive), formatting, and scanning, with support for both narrow and wide characters.

methods.name: SbStringDuplicate
methods.description: Duplicates a string, similar to strdup, with memory allocated via SbMemoryDeallocate.

methods.name: SbStringCompareNoCase
methods.description: Compares two strings ignoring case differences.

methods.name: SbStringCompareNoCaseN
methods.description: Compares first n characters of two strings ignoring case differences.

methods.name: SbStringFormat
methods.description: Formats a string with variable arguments, similar to vsnprintf.

methods.name: SbStringFormatF
methods.description: Inline wrapper for SbStringFormat using variadic arguments.

methods.name: SbStringFormatUnsafeF
methods.description: Unsafe version of SbStringFormatF, using SSIZE_MAX as buffer size.

methods.name: SbStringFormatWide
methods.description: Formats wide-character strings with variable arguments.

methods.name: SbStringFormatWideF
methods.description: Inline wrapper for SbStringFormatWide using variadic arguments.

methods.name: SbStringScan
methods.description: Scans a string for a pattern, extracting values.

methods.name: SbStringScanF
methods.description: Wrapper for SbStringScan with variadic arguments.
